description: GH #326 phase 5c: the registration shaping the captured-splice FFI calls fold behind the native boundary. `operator_text` pins the binary-owned marker normalization (expected values come from the plugin's java.util.regex rule). Each registration pins the three operator texts, whether the plugin's operator-text shortcut answers, the single splice it shapes for the containment proof and for the clean merge (code-point offsets), and the native answers. agent-doc-merge captured_splice_request answers every entry through the `registration` input and through the pre-5c batch path; RegistrationSpliceShapingTest checks the plugin's frozen floor against the same file.
